artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
Create a high-energy Counter-Strike 2 themed Instagram post with a split-left layout. Left side: Bold typography featuring 'CS2 EARLY ODDS LIVE' in Midnight Sans Heavy white text on a dynamic purple (#8D52DA) to dark purple (#300931) gradient background with subtle geometric tech patterns. Right side: Dramatic CS2 game scene with weapon silhouettes (AK-47, AWP) in orange (#FF6B2F) accents, tactical crosshairs, and futuristic HUD elements. Center the subhead 'Get ahead of the competition this weekend' in Inter font below the main headline. Place 'BET NOW' CTA in a bright yellow (#DFFD51) rounded button at bottom. Include small CB notch logo in top-right corner. Overall mood: intense gaming energy with premium esports tournament atmosphere, using sharp angles and neon-style highlights that blend gaming aesthetics with sports betting excitement.
